entities.name: CAG information list
entities.description: Information element used to assign new CAG information list to the UE or delete the CAG information list at the UE side.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that receives or stores the CAG information list.

entities.name: Assign CAG information list
entities.description: Condition where the network assigns a new CAG information list to the UE.

entities.name: Delete CAG information list
entities.description: Condition where the network deletes the stored CAG information list at the UE.

relations.description: The CAG information list IE is used when the network assigns a new CAG list to the UE.
The CAG information list IE is used when the network deletes the stored CAG list at the UE.
Assigning a new CAG information list establishes the UE's stored CAG list.
Deleting the CAG information list establishes that the UE no longer stores the CAG list.
